text.en:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck.
● Extra Deck: Special Summon 1 "White Crow" monster from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Zaltys the White Crow Knight" once per turn.

materials: 1 Illusion-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
